examples.japanese: {迅速|じんそく}に{行動|こうどう}する。
{彼|かれ}の{行動|こうどう}は{理解|りかい}できない。

notes:
{行動|こうどう} refers to purposeful actions or conduct. It emphasizes what someone actively does, rather than passive states or habits.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {行動|こうどう}する: to act, to take action
- {行動|こうどう}に{移|うつ}す: to put into action
- {行動|こうどう}を{起|お}こす: to take action (more forceful)
- {行動|こうどう}{範囲|はんい}: range of activity

COMPOUNDS:
- {行動|こうどう}{力|りょく}: ability to take action, drive
- {集団|しゅうだん}{行動|こうどう}: group action
- {行動|こうどう}{計画|けいかく}: action plan
- {行動|こうどう}{規範|きはん}: code of conduct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行為|こうい}: act, deed (focuses on a single specific act, often with moral or legal implications)
- {振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い: behavior, demeanor (emphasizes outward manner)
